title: Short, strange-looking police officer escorts Michael off restricted land

tellings.quote: He was short. He was short. Face was puffy. He had a hat on. Deputy dog kind of hat like a deputy dog kind of hat from cartoons and stuff.

plain: In 1977, on government land in Nevada, a police officer who looked strange led an Air Force veteran named Michael Johnson off restricted ground, Johnson says. He tells Michels the man "was short," with a "puffy" face and "a deputy dog kind of hat like from cartoons." He tells it as part of a longer story: a sighting and missing time on a drive as a trucker from Texas to Nevada, and the odd figure suggests to him that the officer may not have been an ordinary person.
